data.name: Manab
data.gender_notes: Manab is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Manab is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘manas’, meaning ‘mind’. This name signifies one who possesses a great intellect and wisdom. In Hindu mythology, Manab is associated with Lord Shiva, who is the embodiment of wisdom and knowledge. The name Manab carries the meaning “Intellect, Mind, Wisdom” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Manab usually hope their child will grow to embody intellect, mind, wisdom and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes deep thought and inner wisdom.
data.etymology: Manab belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Intellect, Mind, Wisdom.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Manab total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

historical_references.reference: Manab was a legendary king of the Maratha confederacy in western India during the late 17th century. He is best known for his military campaigns against the Mughal Empire and his reign marked the beginning of Maratha expansion beyond the Deccan plateau.
